subject: Discovery recap & propose next session — side-by-side demo + prep
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medicore.io>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@medicore.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & propose next session — side-by-side demo + prep

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: you are evaluating a hosted inference solution for clinical-note summarization and secure embeddings for search; top priorities are predictable p99 latency, audit logs for model outputs, and a clear cost target under $0.0008/embedding at scale.

Proposed next step: a focused side-by-side tech demo where we (a) show a live inference run on one of your representative notes, (b) walk through routing/fallback policies, and (c) review the audit/logging + retention controls. That'll let the engineering team validate latency and end-to-end observability.

Two candidate 60-minute slots next week (pick one and I’ll send the calendar invite + Zoom):
- Option A: Tue Aug 1, 2028 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed Aug 2, 2028 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (we recommend: 1x engineering lead, 1x security/compliance owner, 1x product owner). I’ve tentatively included Karthik (serving runtime lead) and Marissa (solutions engineering) on the invite.

Prework: if you can drop a short sample (anonymized) note or a few example prompts into the linked Drive doc before the call, we’ll use that during the demo. I attached a draft agenda and a couple of infra notes so you can skim ahead.

Attachments: MedicoRe_Discovery_Agenda_v1.pdf (1 page), infra-notes.png (diagram)
Links: Zoom (will include passcode after slot confirmed), Google Calendar invite (placeholder)

If neither slot works, tell me two windows you prefer and we’ll adjust.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference for engineering teams

Laura —

Thanks for the clear recap and the agenda. Option B (Wed Aug 2, 14:00–15:00 PT) works best for our team. Attendees: myself (Head of Product), Carlos (Engineering Manager), and I’ll bring in Priya from security if we need additional details — I’ll confirm Priya by EOD Tues.

I uploaded two anonymized sample notes to the Drive link you shared in the call (filename: med_re_samples.zip). We’d like to see an apples-to-apples latency and embedding quality comparison during the session. Also, please include any brief guidance on tokenization/formatting you prefer for the notes.

See you on Wed.

Samantha Ortiz

Great — Wed Aug 2 at 14:00 PT is locked on our side. I created the Zoom bridge below and added an event to the calendar; the passcode is included in the invite. Please accept when convenient.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example (Passcode: 4D6r#Z)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=ZXhhbXBsZS1pZA

Marissa and I will prepare two short runs during the demo:

Hi Samantha —

Thanks — confirmed. I attached the security checklist and the 1-slide log-retention overview to this thread (attached: MedicoRe_Discovery_Agenda_v1.pdf, infra-notes.png). Quick notes for the call:

- Please ensure the sample files are de-identified and < 10 MB.
- If Priya joins, we’ll allocate 15 minutes to walkthrough audit logs, key management options (KMS/HSM), and the retention/exports flow.
- If you want us to run through a specific failure/fallback scenario, paste the prompt you want tested into the calendar event notes and we’ll run it live.

See the calendar invite for the Zoom passcode; I’ll add the run order to the description.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
